text_block_list.text: One day, while passing by the dance studio—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
H-Haaaaiii~~♪
It's everyone's beloved El-chan, desuuu~♪

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
...Ugh, no, that's not right! It needs to
reach out and seize the world more intensely!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Heh... So you're aiming for the "world" too, huh.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ¿Qué?! Who's there, desu?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Wait, Golshi-san, why are you here—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Isn't it obvious?! It's 'cause you tossed around
the word "world" all willy-nilly!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Wha—
I didn't say it lightly! I'm genuinely
aiming to be the world's strongest, desu!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Heh, world's strongest, huh... Wonder about that.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
For talkin' so big, I can see hesitation written all over ya...
Wondering, "Is it really okay to keep charging ahead like this?"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: T-That's...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
What're ya fretting so much about? Spit it out!
Is the "world" that terrifying to ya? Well, is it?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
No! When it comes to running, I'll never lose!
Not out in the world, not against anyone! It's just—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Compared to Pearl-senpai, I thought maybe
my performance isn't world-class yet...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
...C'mon now, you're like grilled fish from the supermarket.
Leaving the cooking entirely up to someone else.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Compared to Pearl? Compared to someone else, ya say?
—Quit foolin' around!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Who cares about other people!!
Bring out more of your own flavor, dammit!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: M-My own flavor...?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
That's right! What you're missing is your own seasoning!
Bring out the dashi stock! Become the bonito flake!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you, Trainer over there secretly watchin'!
You think so too, don'tcha?!

I was startled by the sudden question,
but I should say—

I was startled by the sudden question,
but I should say—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: My unique flavor...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
You're right, trying to imitate someone else
wasn't like me at all...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
The El way has always been to paint everyone
in my own colors instead—yes!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I'll take a harder look at myself
and find my own way of doing things!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Heh... That's the spirit. A crab's pincers
exist to grab hold of dreams, after all.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... I should already know deep down
what my own special flavor is...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
El's charm is heat! Passion!
Energy! Vitality!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Then there's no point unless my performance
brings out that exact strength, desu!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
All right, I'm gonna cook up a special performance
that shows off all my best traits!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Heh, you've got good eyes.
...Make sure you become the ruler of the deep sea one day.
